title: Netskope or Palo Alto Prisma SaaS: Securing Cloud Application Use
excerpt: Two approaches to cloud access security brokering (CASB): a specialist built around cloud application security, and a CASB that sits inside Palo Alto's wider security platform.
verdict: Netskope is the more specialised option for deep cloud application visibility and control. Prisma SaaS makes more sense when you want CASB as part of a unified platform with your other Palo Alto products.
